position: Ai or not, your system will break.
title: Your system will break. It just depends when.
description:
Every system you build will fail. Not if but when and how badly.
In this session, I want to go over with the public a few I have seen and discuss them (5 min each). 
I still have to plan this but I am thinking of the following:
- N+1 database & distributed services
- Thundering herd
- fan-out explosions
- retry storms
- Dual Write Problem. 
- Some other ones. 

I would like to try to get the audience involved in solutions. With every solution planting the seed of the next problem. 

In the end, walk with a mental map of failures modes, the vocabulary and the wisdom to choose which problems you'd rather have.
